status: The native Commerce fulfillment slice now writes service completion and Finance-owned per-fulfillment-line Money in one serializable unit. Goods delivery, lot/serial allocation, Inventory stock movement, goods journal, invoicing, settlement and returns remain retained, so sales/orders and sales/fulfillment stay partial. The recorded sales/quotes demotion from the concurrent review is preserved: its save/conversion error precedence must still be reconciled before it returns to verified.

scope.domain: ServiceCompletionCommand/Plan/Receipt validate an exact bounded command: service-only lines, unique line ids, positive three-decimal quantity, no over-fulfillment, completion date not before the order date, confirmed/partially_fulfilled sales order, exact expected version and a mandatory evidence note. Amounts use integer half-up math; a fully completed remaining quantity uses the exact original remainder so rounding never drifts.
scope.application: fulfill_service_order locks the command key, resolves the canonical receipt before writes, validates the work context, locks the order, reads each service line and prior fulfillment subtotal/tax, writes one fulfillment header and line rows, increments fulfilled_milli with a remaining-quantity guard, refreshes the order state/version, writes receipt/audit/outbox and validates persisted readback. A replay returns the original receipt with created=false and never duplicates effects.
scope.adapter: PgCommerceOrders implements the fulfillment repository on the caller's serializable connection: service line facts with prior fulfillment sums, completion header/line inserts, guarded line increment, CAS state refresh and persisted readback.
scope.finance: Finance owns snapshot_commerce_fulfillment_money: the same stable Finance locks/unit verification, configured two-decimal scale, effective-date confirmed rate/fallback, exact USD conversion, and per fulfillment line subtotal/tax/total rows under source_type commerce_fulfillment_line. Rows are re-read and revalidated before the caller continues.
scope.composition: The composed Commerce backend locks Finance sources before the owner write via CommerceSources{money:true}, runs fulfill_service_order, then writes Finance Money rows only when the command created a new fulfillment. Any late failure rolls fulfillment, order state, receipt/audit/outbox and Money back together.
scope.httpAndFrontend: POST /api/v1/holdings/{slug}/commerce/orders/{id}/fulfill accepts only completionMode=service with an exact body, verifies the response, and is selected by the Next route only for service completion. The sales page offers the native action only for confirmed/partially fulfilled sales orders with remaining service lines. The TS transport validates and sends the exact body/key.

verification.commerce: cargo test -p erpx-server-commerce --locked (worktree with installed node_modules and pinned Node/Bun): 69/69 pass across 5 unit, 8 PostgreSQL, 31 order policy/oracle, 8 HTTP, 16 order PostgreSQL and 1 service-count suites.
verification.serviceCompletionPostgres: service_completion_writes_fulfillment_receipt_money_and_replay proves: fulfillment delivery-<key>, state fulfilled, version 4, fulfilled_milli 1000, completion_kind service, exact note, line quantity 1000/value 0/subtotal 10000/tax 700; replay returns the same receipt; exactly 3 commerce_fulfillment_line Money rows; one receipt, audit and outbox row; a second completion on the same order fails closed; a stock line is rejected with SERVICE_COMPLETION_REQUIRED.
verification.http: actual_router_forwards_one_service_completion_exactly proves the exact path/body/key reaches the backend and the receipt is validated; goods mode, unknown keys and empty lines are 422.
verification.transport: native-commerce-orders-transport.test.ts 8/8 pass; the new case asserts the exact JSON body, Idempotency-Key and path for fulfill and rejects empty lines before the wire.
verification.cleanArchive: git archive of the staged tree (tree 691ed7de005f5323844b9f110642305aa71e52e2) passes cargo check -p erpx-service --locked --no-default-features --features private-field-api,files-scan-worker,existing-business.
verification.checks: tsc --noEmit and rustfmt --check pass. Commerce clippy --lib -D warnings passes; Finance clippy still reports only the pre-existing external errors in bank_reconciliation.rs, period_close.rs and pos_sources.rs (unchanged by this slice).

limitations: Only service completion is native. Goods delivery, lot/serial allocation, Inventory stock movement, goods journal, invoicing, settlement and returns remain retained, so sales/fulfillment and sales/orders stay partial.

No browser journey was run for this slice yet; the authorizing evidence is the exact HTTP/transport, PostgreSQL and composition tests. A selected-API/browser service-completion journey remains required before any workflow closure claim.

The concurrent review demoted sales/quotes to partial for save/conversion error-precedence differences against the full TypeScript/PostgreSQL oracle. That finding is preserved and must be fixed before sales/quotes returns to verified.
nextAction: Reconcile the Commerce save/conversion error precedence against the full TypeScript oracle and restore sales/quotes, then browser-verify service completion through the selected route and continue goods fulfillment/invoicing/settlement/returns.
